capabilities: Preview .pptx, .docx, .xlsx and 130+ code formats with selectable text
Search text within slides, documents, workbooks and code files
Add margin comments and highlights saved as sidecar Markdown notes
Export decks, Word documents and workbooks as Markdown notes
Index all comments across the vault in a Bases view
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.14+; distributed via GitHub releases and marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Makes no network requests, but on Windows converts EMF/WMF slide images via PowerShell to the system temp folder. PDF comments use non-public Obsidian API and self-disable if an update breaks them.
intentEvidence: Other preview plugins draw slides to a canvas, which is just pixels.
problem: Obsidian cannot open Office files natively, and other slide previewers render slides as non-selectable images with no way to annotate or copy text.

relations.evidence: It also stays off while PDF++ is enabled.

summary: File previewer for PowerPoint, Word, Excel, PDF and 130+ code formats with selectable text, Word-style margin comments, and Markdown export.
